latestVersion.changelog:
Prompt Crafting Lab 1.0.0 – Initial Release

- Launches an interactive, educational skill focused on hands-on coaching to refine AI prompts.
- Guides users through a structured, multi-step workflow to improve prompts for tools like ChatGPT or Claude.
- Explains core prompt engineering principles (role-setting, specificity, constraints, output formatting, chain-of-thought).
- Provides iterative feedback and annotated revisions of user prompts, plus alternatives for different scenarios.
- Ensures safety by refusing tasks related to harm, cheating, or bypassing AI guardrails and does not test prompts live.
